era: Late-2019 Los Angeles Times (the California Times platform that article and section pages used from mid-2019 and the home page from autumn 2019, captured 2019-07 to 2019-12): white top bar with a boxed '☰ Sections' button, sentence-case bold sans section links, boxed search button, the blackletter logo centered, grey uppercase topic chips, serif headlines, uppercase grey category labels and red timestamps. The older Tribune home page (dark TOPICS/SEARCH bar, grey page, white cards) was still on the home page in 2019-05 and 2019-07 but was retired later in 2019, so the majority of 2019 captures (article, sections, search, December home) show the new design.
